title: What to Say When Following Up on a Job Application ✍️
description:
Following up after a job interview is an absoltuely crucial step in the job search, but what should you even write? No worries on that front we have you covered. If your job is in the “interviewing” stage head to the communications template panel and look for “follow up”. Then simply swap out the placeholders with specific details and you’re good to go! #jobinterview #jobinterviewtips #jobsearchtips
